name: Summer STEM Bridge
what_you_do: Take two college classes in person over eight weeks. One class is network security. The other is a math class. You also go on two field trips to Idaho National Laboratory and build a portfolio.
grades: High school sophomore, junior or senior in the 2026/2027 school year, or a 2026 graduate
who_can_apply: High school students who meet one or more rules, such as being an Idaho resident or attending an Idaho high school, or being 16. Sophomores who are not yet 16 on the first day of class need an age waiver. Homeschool students can join if they meet the same age or grade level.
pay_detail: Free. All student costs are covered by grants, scholarships or state funding. Earn 5 to 6 college credits.
duration: 8 weeks, Tuesday to Thursday mornings (June 2 to July 23 in 2026)
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran June 2 to July 23, 2026. Registration was completed by May. The program page does not mention a 2027 session.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form to hold a spot on the waiting list. Go to the information meeting. Then finish official registration and send your transcript and test scores.
notes: Classes meet in person on the Idaho Falls campus. Hours were 8:30 am to 1:00 pm. Check the page next spring to see if the program returns.
